about_the_game:
CONE CRUSHERS: DEMO

Build. Race. Crush.

This free demo gives you both complete Cone Crushers track builders plus a test car to thrash around your creations. Design complex autocross layouts using the first-person or UI editor, then attack them against the clock. Create, experiment, and experience the foundation of Cone Crushers.

Demo Features:

  • Precise cone placement tools with Start and Finish lines. 

  • Realistic physics that punish mistakes and reward skill

  • Customizable time of day

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380 with 2GB VRAM or equivale
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / AMD RX Vega 56 with 8GB VRAM or equivalent
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
